spans.quotation: We have committed to multiple targets for reducing operational (Scope 1 and Scope 2) emissions over which the company has ownership. Our targets are: Reduce GHG emissions intensity to 50-60% by 2030 on both a gross operated and net equity basis from a 2016 baseline. Achieve near-zero methane emissions intensity by 2030. Reduce methane emissions intensity by 10% by 2025 from a 2019 baseline. Achieve a target of zero routine flaring by the end of 2025, five years sooner than the World Bank initiative's goal of 2030 (excluding heritage Marathon Oil assets).

Achieved target-related GHG intensity reductions, from a 2016 baseline: 45% reduction on a gross operated basis 36% reduction on a net equity basis. Executing projects to reduce GHG emissions intensity to 50-60% by 2030, on both gross operated and net equity basis from 2016 baseline.

The minimum boundary for reporting on environmental priorities is the assets we operate. Current and updated targets and ambitions are outlined in near, medium and long-term timeframes. Our progress to date has not included the use of voluntary offsets.

note: criteria 1, 2, 4, 5 — 4 of 5. Criterion 1 satisfied by four named targets with specific figures: 50–60% GHG intensity reduction, near-zero methane intensity, 10% methane reduction by 2025, zero routine flaring by 2025 (Span 1, page 25); and 45%/36% progress figures (Span 2, page 25). Criterion 2 satisfied by explicit baseline years (2016 for GHG intensity; 2019 for methane) and target years (2030; 2025) in Span 1. Criterion 3 judgment call: Span 3 states the minimum boundary (operated assets), Span 1 states dual gross operated and net equity scope, and the offset exclusion note constitutes a target boundary methodology statement — however, this is boundary-focused rather than calculation-methodology-focused and is flagged as a calibration candidate for Criterion 3. Criterion 4 satisfied by 2025 near-term and 2030 medium-term target years and the near/medium/long-term horizon framing (Spans 1 and 3). Criterion 5 satisfied by 45% gross operated and 36% net equity reductions achieved from 2016 baseline to 2024 (Span 2, page 25). coverage_scope = corporate: targets apply to full company operations on both gross operated and net equity bases. trend_disclosed = false: Span 2 provides a point-in-time progress snapshot against baseline, not a multi-year annual data series across anchor + 2 prior years. Boundary note: detailed milestone progress (OGMP Gold Standard, pneumatic device removal, routine flaring to 4 MMCF) in the progress column of page 25 belongs to M6, not M5. Cross-concept note: Span 3 boundary statement also provides supporting context for F1 if F1 evidence is limited.
